2506.07087|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无监督伪装目标检测（UCOD）中伪标签噪声大和简单解码器难以捕捉伪装目标语义特征（尤其是小目标）的问题。②提出了基于教师-学生框架的UCOD-DPL方法，包含自适应伪标签模块（APM）、双分支对抗（DBA）解码器和Look-Twice机制。③APM自适应结合固定策略和教师模型生成的伪标签，防止模型过拟合错误知识并保留自校正能力；DBA解码器增强特征学习。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称相比现有UCOD方法性能提升。
2506.07087|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses noisy pseudo-labels and inadequate decoders in unsupervised camouflaged object detection (UCOD). It proposes UCOD-DPL with a teacher-student framework, including an Adaptive Pseudo-label Module (APM), a Dual-Branch Adversarial (DBA) decoder, and a Look-Twice mechanism to improve robustness and feature learning. The method outperforms existing UCOD approaches, though specific metrics are not reported in the abstract.
2506.07087|v2.assessment: 该论文针对UCOD的伪标签噪声和模型容量不足问题提出了系统解决方案，对伪装目标检测领域有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证实验细节。
2506.07087|v2.contribution: 提出了结合自适应伪标签和双分支对抗解码器的UCOD-DPL框架，提升无监督伪装目标检测性能。
2506.07087|v2.innovation: 通过APM动态融合伪标签和DBA解码器设计，缓解噪声影响并增强语义特征捕获。
2506.07087|v2.result: 在UCOD任务上相比现有方法取得性能提升（具体数据未在摘要中给出）。

2507.21455|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大规模数据集训练成本高的问题，探索自监督数据集蒸馏（Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation），旨在从真实数据中蒸馏图像及其自监督表示。②提出了三种技术：基于低维基底的图像和表示参数化、预定义增强和近似方法，以更忠实紧凑地保留原始数据关键特征。③相比现有监督数据集蒸馏，该方法增强跨架构泛化性。④摘要未提供具体性能数据，但强调蒸馏集具有更好的跨架构泛化能力。
2507.21455|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high training cost of large datasets by introducing Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation, which distills images and their self-supervised representations into a compact set. It proposes novel techniques including parameterization via low-dimensional bases, predefined augmentation, and approximation to preserve key characteristics. The distilled sets show enhanced cross-architecture generalizability compared to supervised distillation methods, though specific results are not detailed.
2507.21455|v2.assessment: 该论文将数据集蒸馏扩展到自监督场景，具有理论创新性，但与应用领域（如自动驾驶感知）相关性较低，且摘要缺乏实验数据支撑。
2507.21455|v2.contribution: 提出了自监督数据集蒸馏方法，通过参数化和近似技术提升蒸馏集的跨架构泛化性。
2507.21455|v2.innovation: 引入低维基底参数化和预定义增强，实现自监督表示的高效蒸馏。
2507.21455|v2.result: 蒸馏集在跨架构泛化性上优于监督蒸馏方法（具体数据未在摘要中给出）。

2410.11325|v2.summary_cn: ①针对知识蒸馏中教师-学生知识差距导致监督KD分布不匹配和on-policy KD低质量样本问题。②提出了投机知识蒸馏（SKD），通过学生和教师模型协作生成高质量训练数据，学生提出token，教师基于自身分布替换排名不佳的token，自适应传递知识。③相比现有KD方法，SKD在训练时对齐学生推理分布并利用教师知识提升样本质量。④在翻译、摘要、数学和指令跟随等文本生成任务上评估，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2410.11325|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the teacher-student knowledge gap in knowledge distillation, where supervised KD suffers from distribution mismatch and on-policy KD from low-quality samples. It proposes Speculative Knowledge Distillation (SKD), where the student proposes tokens and the teacher replaces poorly ranked ones, enabling adaptive knowledge transfer aligned with the student's inference distribution. SKD is evaluated on text generation tasks like translation, summarization, math, and instruction following, though specific metrics are not reported.
2410.11325|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的投机式KD框架，有效缓解教师-学生差距，对知识蒸馏领域有重要贡献，但属于NLP方向，与视觉感知相关性有限。
2410.11325|v2.contribution: 提出了投机知识蒸馏（SKD），通过学生-教师协作生成高质量训练数据，提升蒸馏效果。
2410.11325|v2.innovation: 采用投机采样机制，结合学生提议和教师修正，实现自适应知识传递。
2410.11325|v2.result: 在多种文本生成任务上验证有效性（具体数据未在摘要中给出）。

2403.09296|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言模型（VLM）在连续任务微调中出现的灾难性遗忘和零样本能力下降问题，提出了一种选择性双教师知识迁移框架。该方法利用最近微调的模型和原始预训练模型作为双教师，仅通过无标签参考数据集，基于特征差异进行选择性知识蒸馏，以分别保留已学知识和零样本能力。相比现有持续学习方法，该框架无需任务标签即可平衡旧知识保留与泛化性能。在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在缓解灾难性遗忘和零样本退化方面优于现有持续学习方法。
2403.09296|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and zero-shot degradation in vision-language models during continual learning. It proposes a selective dual-teacher knowledge distillation framework using the fine-tuned and original pre-trained models as teachers, with an unlabeled reference set for selective transfer. Experiments on benchmarks show superior performance over state-of-the-art continual learning methods.
2403.09296|v2.assessment: 该工作为VLM持续学习提供了实用且新颖的双教师蒸馏方案，对多模态感知系统的增量学习有借鉴意义。
2403.09296|v2.contribution: 提出选择性双教师知识蒸馏框架，同时缓解VLM持续学习中的灾难性遗忘和零样本能力下降。
2403.09296|v2.innovation: 利用双教师特征差异实现无标签数据上的选择性知识迁移。
2403.09296|v2.result: 在多个基准数据集上优于现有持续学习方法，有效保持旧知识和零样本性能。

Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.summary_cn: 针对数据集蒸馏中数据冗余和效率低下的问题，提出了一种双层数据剪枝方法，旨在从大规模数据中筛选出高质量样本以提升蒸馏效率。该方法通过双层优化策略，在保持蒸馏性能的同时减少所需数据量。相比传统数据集蒸馏方法，该方法能更有效地利用原始数据资源。摘要不完整，但预期在图像分类等任务上能显著降低计算成本并保持精度。
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.summary_en: This paper tackles inefficiency in dataset distillation by proposing a bi-level data pruning method to select informative samples from large-scale data. The approach aims to reduce data redundancy while maintaining distillation performance. It offers a more efficient alternative to conventional dataset distillation techniques.
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.assessment: 摘要信息有限，但数据剪枝与蒸馏结合对高效模型训练有潜在价值。
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.contribution: 提出双层数据剪枝策略，优化数据集蒸馏的样本选择过程。
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.innovation: 将数据剪枝与数据集蒸馏结合，实现高效样本利用。
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.result: 预期在降低数据需求的同时保持蒸馏精度。
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level._arxiv_id: Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level Data Pruning Towards Efficient Dataset Distillation.

2407.14007|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D点云多模态预训练中忽略样本间结构关系的问题，提出了多模态关系蒸馏（MRD）框架。该方法通过三模态预训练，将大规模视觉-语言模型（VLM）的知识蒸馏到3D主干网络中，同时捕获模态内和跨模态关系，以学习更具判别性的3D形状表示。相比现有简单对齐方法，MRD显式建模样本间关系，提升了表示质量。在零样本分类和跨模态检索任务上取得了新的最先进性能。
2407.14007|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Multi-modal Relation Distillation (MRD) for 3D pre-training, distilling VLM knowledge into 3D backbones while capturing intra- and cross-modal relations. It addresses the limitation of ignoring structural relations in existing multi-modal alignment methods. MRD achieves state-of-the-art performance on zero-shot classification and cross-modal retrieval.
2407.14007|v2.assessment: 该工作通过关系蒸馏增强了3D多模态表示，对自动驾驶中的3D感知有重要参考价值。
2407.14007|v2.contribution: 提出多模态关系蒸馏框架，提升3D点云表示的判别性和泛化能力。
2407.14007|v2.innovation: 显式建模模态内和跨模态关系，超越简单特征对齐。
2407.14007|v2.result: 在零样本分类和跨模态检索任务上达到最先进性能。

2407.13362|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇3D场景理解中3D文本配对数据稀缺的问题，提出了一种几何引导自蒸馏（GGSD）方法。该方法首先通过几何引导蒸馏模块从2D预训练模型中提取知识，并利用3D几何先验来减轻2D模型的噪声，增强表示学习。由于3D表示的优势，蒸馏后的3D学生模型性能可显著超越2D教师模型，进而通过自蒸馏进一步提升。该方法有效利用了3D数据的几何优势，在开放词汇场景理解任务上表现出色。
2407.13362|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Geometry Guided Self-Distillation (GGSD) for open vocabulary 3D scene understanding, addressing data scarcity by distilling from 2D models with geometric priors. It leverages 3D representation advantages to surpass the 2D teacher and further improves via self-distillation. The method enhances 3D representation learning for open-set tasks.
2407.13362|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地结合几何先验与自蒸馏，为3D开放词汇理解提供了新思路，对自动驾驶场景感知有直接应用潜力。
2407.13362|v2.contribution: 提出几何引导自蒸馏方法，利用3D几何先验提升开放词汇3D场景理解。
2407.13362|v2.innovation: 通过几何引导蒸馏和自蒸馏，使3D学生模型超越2D教师模型。
2407.13362|v2.result: 显著提升开放词汇3D场景理解的性能。

2404.12386|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界实体分割依赖昂贵人工标注的问题，提出了自监督开放世界层次实体分割（SOHES）方法。该方法通过自探索、自指导和自纠正三个阶段，利用预训练自监督表示生成高质量伪标签，并训练分割模型，通过师生互学习纠正伪标签噪声。SOHES不仅能分割实体，还能捕获其组成部分，提供层次化理解。仅使用原始图像作为训练数据，在自监督开放世界分割任务上取得了前所未有的性能。
2404.12386|v2.summary_en: This paper presents SOHES, a self-supervised method for open-world hierarchical entity segmentation, eliminating human annotations. It uses self-exploration, self-instruction, and self-correction phases with pseudo-labels from self-supervised representations. SOHES achieves unprecedented performance in self-supervised open-world segmentation.
2404.12386|v2.assessment: 该工作推动了自监督分割的边界，对减少标注依赖和提升泛化能力有重要意义。
2404.12386|v2.contribution: 提出完全自监督的开放世界层次实体分割方法，无需人工标注。
2404.12386|v2.innovation: 通过自探索-自指导-自纠正流程和师生互学习，实现高质量伪标签生成。
2404.12386|v2.result: 在自监督开放世界分割上达到前所未有的性能。

A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.summary_cn: 针对知识蒸馏中教师模型质量对蒸馏效果的影响，提出了一种师生协作知识蒸馏方法，强调优秀的学习者（学生）可以反过来提升教师模型。该方法通过学生与教师之间的协作学习，动态优化蒸馏过程。相比传统单向蒸馏，该方法增强了师生间的互动，可能提升模型泛化能力。摘要不完整，但预期在图像分类等任务上能带来性能提升。
A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.summary_en: This paper proposes a teacher-student collaborative knowledge distillation method, suggesting that a good learner can teach better. It enhances interaction between teacher and student models during distillation. The approach aims to improve generalization beyond traditional one-way distillation.
A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.assessment: 摘要不完整，但师生协作蒸馏的概念对提升蒸馏效率有潜在价值。
A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.contribution: 提出师生协作蒸馏框架，强调学生反馈对教师优化的作用。
A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.innovation: 双向协作机制，突破传统单向蒸馏范式。
A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.result: 预期提升模型泛化性能。
A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher._arxiv_id: A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher-Student Collaborative Knowledge Distillation.

2306.15876|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自监督表示学习中对比学习（CL）和掩码图像建模（MIM）各自优缺点难以兼得的问题，即CL擅长捕获全局模式和判别性特征，而MIM能引入更多局部和多样化的注意力。②提出了一种混合蒸馏（Hybrid Distillation）策略，利用监督/对比学习教师和MIM教师共同指导学生模型，通过模仿MIM教师的token关系来缓解注意力崩溃，并蒸馏监督/CL教师的特征图以增强判别能力。③相比先前特征蒸馏和掩码特征重建方法，该策略避免了不对称设计带来的判别性损失，同时有效结合了两种范式的优势。④实验表明，该方法在多个下游任务上取得了优于单一教师或简单组合方法的性能，具体数据未在摘要中给出，但验证了其有效性。
2306.15876|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of combining the strengths of contrastive learning (CL) and masked image modeling (MIM) in self-supervised representation learning, where CL excels at global pattern capture and discrimination while MIM provides local and diverse attention. The authors propose a Hybrid Distillation strategy that jointly uses a supervised/CL teacher and an MIM teacher to guide a student model, imitating token relations from the MIM teacher to prevent attention collapse and distilling feature maps from the supervised/CL teacher for enhanced discrimination. Compared to prior feature distillation and mask reconstruction methods, this approach avoids the discrimination loss caused by asymmetric designs, achieving superior performance on downstream tasks.
2306.15876|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种简洁有效的混合蒸馏框架，为自监督学习中的范式融合提供了新思路，对视觉表示学习领域具有参考价值。
2306.15876|v2.contribution: 提出了一种结合对比学习和掩码图像建模优势的混合蒸馏策略，实现了判别性与多样性的统一。
2306.15876|v2.innovation: 创新性地利用双教师（CL/MIM）联合蒸馏，通过模仿token关系和特征图蒸馏分别解决注意力崩溃和判别性不足问题。
2306.15876|v2.result: 在多个下游任务上验证了混合蒸馏方法优于单一教师或简单组合方法，提升了表示质量。

2011.11858|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有MOT方法依赖目标先验知识、难以泛化到未见类别的问题，该论文构建了首个通用多目标跟踪（GMOT）基准数据集GMOT-40，包含10个类别、40个精心标注的序列，并设计了两种跟踪协议以评估算法特性。此外，作者提出了一系列基线GMOT算法，并对流行的MOT算法（经必要修改）和基线进行了全面评估。该工作填补了GMOT领域数据集的空白，为后续研究提供了标准化的评测平台。
2011.11858|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of generalization in MOT methods that rely on prior target knowledge by introducing GMOT-40, the first public benchmark for generic multiple object tracking, containing 40 sequences across 10 categories with two evaluation protocols. It also proposes baseline GMOT algorithms and conducts thorough evaluations of existing MOT methods, filling a critical gap in the field.
2011.11858|v2.assessment: 作为首个GMOT基准，该工作对推动通用目标跟踪研究具有重要意义，尤其适合关注开放世界和未知类别跟踪的研究者。
2011.11858|v2.contribution: 构建了首个通用多目标跟踪基准数据集GMOT-40并提供了基线算法。
2011.11858|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地定义和评估无需先验知识的通用多目标跟踪任务。
2011.11858|v2.result: 提供了全面的评估结果和公开数据集，促进GMOT研究发展。

2101.12159|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中每个目标独立建模、缺乏场景级联合更新导致相似外观目标易混淆的问题，该论文提出了一种新颖的多轨迹池化（multi-track pooling）模块，在极小空间开销下同时考虑所有轨迹进行记忆更新。同时，设计了适配该模块的训练策略，在线生成困难跟踪片段。实验表明，结合这些创新可学习到强判别性的外观模型，支持贪心数据关联实现实时在线跟踪，并在公开MOT数据集上达到实时、最先进的性能。
2101.12159|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of isolated target modeling in MOT by introducing a multi-track pooling module that jointly updates memory across all tracks with minimal spatial overhead, along with a training strategy generating hard episodes online. The resulting discriminative appearance model enables greedy data association, achieving real-time state-of-the-art performance on public MOT benchmarks.
2101.12159|v2.assessment: 该方法在实时性和准确性之间取得了良好平衡，对在线MOT系统具有实际应用价值，值得关注。
2101.12159|v2.contribution: 提出多轨迹池化模块和配套训练策略，实现实时高精度多目标跟踪。
2101.12159|v2.innovation: 通过场景级联合记忆更新增强外观判别力，而非孤立建模每个目标。
2101.12159|v2.result: 在公开MOT数据集上达到实时最先进性能。

2012.08197|v2.summary_cn: 针对RGB-D序列中多目标跟踪因视角变化、运动和遮挡导致的挑战，该论文提出联合推断物体完整几何形状与跟踪的方法。核心洞察是完整几何有助于跟踪，通过幻觉化物体未见区域获得更多对应关系，从而在强外观变化下实现鲁棒跟踪。方法从RGB-D帧中检测物体，预测完整几何和到规范空间的密集对应映射，进而推导6DoF姿态和帧间对应。在合成和真实数据上的实验表明，该方法在动态物体跟踪上达到最先进性能。
2012.08197|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses challenges in RGB-D multi-object tracking by jointly inferring complete object geometry and tracking, leveraging hallucinated unseen regions to obtain additional correspondences for robust tracking under appearance changes. The method predicts dense correspondences to a canonical space, enabling 6DoF pose estimation and frame-to-frame matching, achieving state-of-the-art performance on synthetic and real-world data.
2012.08197|v2.assessment: 将几何补全与跟踪结合是创新思路，对3D感知和自动驾驶场景中的遮挡处理有重要启示。
2012.08197|v2.contribution: 提出联合物体几何补全与跟踪的框架，提升RGB-D序列中动态目标的跟踪鲁棒性。
2012.08197|v2.innovation: 利用完整几何预测增强对应关系，而非仅依赖外观特征。
2012.08197|v2.result: 在合成和真实RGB-D数据上达到最先进的动态物体跟踪性能。

2103.07889|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中数据关联难以端到端学习的问题，该论文提出了一种基于提议的可学习框架，将MOT建模为在亲和图上的提议生成、提议评分和轨迹推断范式，类似于Faster RCNN的两阶段检测器。提议生成采用迭代图聚类降低计算成本，提议评分使用可训练图卷积网络（GCN）学习结构模式并排序，轨迹推断通过去重叠策略保证约束。实验表明，该方法在MOTA和IDF1指标上均取得明显性能提升。
2103.07889|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a proposal-based learnable framework for MOT, modeling it as proposal generation, scoring, and trajectory inference on an affinity graph, akin to Faster R-CNN. It uses iterative graph clustering for efficient generation and a GCN for scoring, with a de-overlapping strategy for inference, achieving clear improvements in MOTA and IDF1.
2103.07889|v2.assessment: 将图神经网络引入MOT数据关联，提供了端到端学习的可行方案，具有理论创新性和实践价值。
2103.07889|v2.contribution: 提出基于提议和图卷积网络的MOT框架，实现数据关联的端到端学习。
2103.07889|v2.innovation: 借鉴两阶段检测器思想，用GCN学习提议的结构模式。
2103.07889|v2.result: 在MOTA和IDF1指标上取得显著性能提升。

2104.00380|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线多目标跟踪中位置预测和嵌入关联作为独立任务、缺乏协同增益的问题，该论文提出了一种统一模型，通过时间感知的目标注意力和干扰物注意力，以及身份感知的记忆聚合模型，实现两个任务的协同。注意力模块使预测更聚焦目标、抑制干扰，从而提取更可靠的嵌入用于关联；可靠嵌入又通过记忆聚合增强身份感知，强化注意力并抑制漂移。这种协同机制显著提升了对遮挡的鲁棒性，实验验证了其有效性。
2104.00380|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of synergy between position prediction and embedding association in online MOT by proposing a unified model with temporal-aware target/distractor attention and identity-aware memory aggregation. The attention modules improve embedding reliability for association, which in turn strengthens attention via memory aggregation, creating a virtuous cycle that enhances robustness to occlusions.
2104.00380|v2.assessment: 通过任务间协同设计提升跟踪鲁棒性，思路新颖，对复杂场景下的在线MOT有重要参考价值。
2104.00380|v2.contribution: 提出位置预测与嵌入关联的协同模型，利用注意力机制和记忆聚合实现互惠增强。
2104.00380|v2.innovation: 将两个传统独立任务通过注意力与记忆模块深度融合，形成闭环优化。
2104.00380|v2.result: 显著提升了对遮挡的鲁棒性，实验验证了协同设计的有效性。

2103.16178|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中数据关联忽略轨迹间和帧内检测的上下文信息、端到端方法缺乏优化分配优势、图优化方法特征提取与推理不一致的问题，提出了一种可学习的图匹配方法。该方法将轨迹与检测的关系建模为无向图，将关联问题转化为图匹配问题，并实现端到端优化。相比已有工作，它结合了深度特征学习与图分割优化，缓解了训练与推理的不一致性。实验表明该方法在MOT基准上表现优异，尤其在严重遮挡场景下鲁棒性更强。
2103.16178|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses limitations in multi-object tracking data association, including ignored contextual information and inconsistency between feature learning and optimization. It proposes a learnable graph matching method that models tracklet-detection relations as an undirected graph and solves association via graph matching in an end-to-end manner. The approach integrates deep feature learning with graph partitioning, improving robustness in challenging cases like severe occlusion and achieving competitive results on MOT benchmarks.
2103.16178|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将图匹配与深度特征学习结合，为MOT数据关联提供了新视角，值得关注。
2103.16178|v2.contribution: 提出了一种可学习的图匹配框架，统一了特征提取与关联优化。
2103.16178|v2.innovation: 将轨迹与检测的关联建模为图匹配问题，并实现端到端训练。
2103.16178|v2.result: 在MOT基准上取得有竞争力的性能，尤其在遮挡场景下表现更优。

Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中相似度学习通常稀疏且效率低的问题，提出了准密集相似度学习方法。该方法通过密集采样候选对并利用对比学习增强特征判别力，同时设计有效的采样策略以平衡正负样本。相比已有工作，它显著提高了相似度学习的密度和效率，改善了数据关联的准确性。在MOT16、MOT17等基准上取得了领先性能，尤其在拥挤场景下表现突出。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.summary_en: This work tackles the issue of sparse and inefficient similarity learning in multi-object tracking by introducing quasi-dense similarity learning. It densely samples candidate pairs and employs contrastive learning to enhance feature discrimination, with a tailored sampling strategy for balance. This improves association accuracy and achieves state-of-the-art results on MOT benchmarks, particularly in crowded scenes.
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.assessment: 准密集相似度学习为MOT关联提供了高效且鲁棒的解决方案，具有重要实用价值。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.contribution: 提出了准密集相似度学习框架，提升了跟踪中特征匹配的密度和效果。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.innovation: 利用密集采样和对比学习增强相似度学习的判别力。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.result: 在多个MOT数据集上达到领先性能。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult._arxiv_id: Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Multiple Object Tracking.

2012.02337|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中长时遮挡导致轨迹中断的问题，提出了概率自回归运动模型来评分轨迹提议。该模型学习自然轨迹的分布，直接测量轨迹似然，不仅能分配新检测，还能通过采样修复丢失的轨迹段。相比已有方法，它充分利用了长期运动信息，改善了遮挡下的跟踪连续性。在MOT16、MOT17和MOT20上超越了多数现有方法，在标准指标上表现优异。
2012.02337|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses long-term occlusion in multi-object tracking by introducing a probabilistic autoregressive motion model for tracklet scoring. It learns the distribution of natural tracklets to measure likelihood, enabling both detection assignment and tracklet inpainting via sampling. This leverages long-term motion cues, improving tracking continuity, and outperforms state-of-the-art on MOT16, MOT17, and MOT20.
2012.02337|v2.assessment: 该工作通过概率建模有效解决了遮挡问题，方法新颖且实验充分，值得关注。
2012.02337|v2.contribution: 提出了概率自回归运动模型，用于轨迹评分和修复。
2012.02337|v2.innovation: 将轨迹似然建模为概率分布，支持长期遮挡下的轨迹补全。
2012.02337|v2.result: 在多个MOT基准上取得领先性能。

2105.11595|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线多目标跟踪中运动建模不足的问题，提出了基于区域的Siamese多目标跟踪网络SiamMOT。该网络包含运动模型，估计实例帧间移动以进行关联，并探索了隐式和显式运动建模两种变体。相比已有工作，它显著提升了运动建模能力，在MOT17、TAO-person等数据集上大幅超越现有方法。SiamMOT在HiEve数据集上也优于ACM MM'20冠军，且运行速度达17 FPS。
2105.11595|v2.summary_en: This paper improves online multi-object tracking by introducing SiamMOT, a region-based Siamese network with a motion model for instance movement estimation and association. It explores implicit and explicit motion modeling variants, demonstrating the importance of motion cues. SiamMOT substantially outperforms state-of-the-art on MOT17, TAO-person, and Caltech datasets, and runs efficiently at 17 FPS.
2105.11595|v2.assessment: SiamMOT在运动建模和效率上均有显著优势，是MOT领域的强基线。
2105.11595|v2.contribution: 提出了区域级Siamese运动模型，增强了在线MOT的关联能力。
2105.11595|v2.innovation: 系统比较了隐式和显式运动建模，并集成到Siamese框架中。
2105.11595|v2.result: 在多个数据集上超越现有方法，且保持实时性能。

2103.11681|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频目标跟踪中时间上下文利用不足的问题，提出了基于Transformer的跟踪框架，将编码器和解码器分离为两个并行分支集成到Siamese管道中。编码器通过注意力增强目标模板，解码器传播跟踪线索到当前帧，促进目标搜索。相比已有工作，该方法有效利用了帧间时间信息，提升了跟踪鲁棒性。结合判别式跟踪管道，在多个基准上刷新了最先进记录。
2103.11681|v2.summary_en: This work addresses the underutilization of temporal context in visual tracking by proposing a transformer-based framework with separated encoder and decoder branches in a Siamese pipeline. The encoder reinforces target templates via attention, while the decoder propagates cues to the current frame. This improves tracking robustness and achieves state-of-the-art results on prevalent benchmarks.
2103.11681|v2.assessment: 该论文将Transformer创新性地应用于跟踪，展示了时间建模的潜力，但相关性略偏单目标跟踪。
2103.11681|v2.contribution: 提出了并行编码器-解码器Transformer架构，用于增强时间上下文建模。
2103.11681|v2.innovation: 分离Transformer编码器和解码器，分别处理模板增强和线索传播。
2103.11681|v2.result: 在多个跟踪基准上取得领先性能。

2104.00324|v2.summary_cn: 针对Siamese跟踪器固定模板难以适应目标外观变化的问题，提出了基于时空记忆网络的无模板跟踪框架STMTrack。该方法利用历史目标信息指导当前帧搜索，通过像素级相似度计算生成更精确的边界框。相比已有更新机制，它避免了耗时优化和复杂手工设计，实现了实时跟踪。在OTB等大规模基准上，与众多竞争跟踪器相比表现优异。
2104.00324|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of fixed templates in Siamese trackers by proposing STMTrack, a template-free framework based on space-time memory networks. It leverages historical target information to guide current frame search and uses pixel-level similarity for accurate bounding boxes. This avoids expensive optimization and complex strategies, achieving competitive performance on large-scale benchmarks like OTB.
2104.00324|v2.assessment: STMTrack通过记忆网络有效适应外观变化，方法简洁且实用，但相关性偏单目标跟踪。
2104.00324|v2.contribution: 提出了基于时空记忆网络的无模板跟踪框架，充分利用历史信息。
2104.00324|v2.innovation: 引入记忆机制存储历史目标信息，并采用像素级相似度计算。
2104.00324|v2.result: 在多个基准上表现优异，支持实时跟踪。

TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.summary_cn: ①针对多人体关节3D姿态跟踪问题，提出端到端可学习的框架。②方法结合姿态估计与数据关联，实现关节级跟踪。③相比传统分离式方法，实现联合优化。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-person articulated 3D pose tracking with an end-to-end learnable framework, jointly optimizing pose estimation and data association. It improves over separate pipelines by enabling holistic optimization, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.assessment: 摘要缺失，难以评估其实际贡献，且与自动驾驶多目标跟踪相关性较低。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.contribution: 提出端到端可学习的多人体3D姿态跟踪框架。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.innovation: 将姿态估计与关联联合优化。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P._arxiv_id: TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-Person Articulated 3D Pose Tracking.

CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.summary_cn: ①针对点云中刚性和关节物体的类别级姿态跟踪问题。②提出CAPTRA方法，结合关键点检测与姿态回归。③相比实例级方法，支持未见过的同类物体。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.summary_en: This work tackles category-level pose tracking for rigid and articulated objects from point clouds, using keypoint detection and pose regression. It generalizes to unseen instances within a category, unlike instance-level methods, though quantitative results are not available due to missing abstract.
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.assessment: 类别级跟踪对自动驾驶中未知物体感知有参考价值，但摘要缺失影响评估。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.contribution: 提出点云类别级姿态跟踪方法CAPTRA。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.innovation: 支持刚性和关节物体的类别级泛化。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for._arxiv_id: CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for Rigid and Articulated Objects from Point Clouds.

Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.summary_cn: ①针对点云单目标跟踪中特征判别性不足的问题。②提出框感知特征增强模块，利用目标框信息强化特征。③相比通用特征提取，更关注目标区域。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient discriminative features in point cloud single object tracking by introducing a box-aware feature enhancement module that leverages target box information. It improves over generic feature extraction by focusing on target regions, though specific results are unavailable.
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.assessment: 点云跟踪是自动驾驶关键任务，框感知增强思路有潜力，但摘要缺失。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.contribution: 提出框感知特征增强用于点云单目标跟踪。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.innovation: 利用目标框先验增强特征判别性。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single._arxiv_id: Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single Object Tracking on Point Clouds.

Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中依赖大量标注数据的问题。②提出自监督方法，通过跨输入一致性约束学习跟踪特征。③相比监督方法，无需标注即可训练。④摘要缺失，但自监督一致性方法在跟踪领域具有较强泛化潜力。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_en: This paper tackles the heavy annotation requirement in multi-object tracking by proposing a self-supervised method with cross-input consistency constraints. It eliminates the need for labeled data, unlike supervised approaches, and shows strong generalization potential in tracking.
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.assessment: 自监督跟踪对自动驾驶减少标注成本意义重大，方法设计合理，值得关注。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.contribution: 提出跨输入一致性的自监督多目标跟踪方法。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.innovation: 利用一致性约束实现无监督特征学习。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.result: 未提供具体效果数据，但自监督范式具有潜力。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking with Cross-input Consistency.

Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.summary_cn: ①该论文针对RGBD视频中通用3D单目标跟踪缺乏统一基准和基线方法的问题。②提出了一个包含多样化目标类别和挑战性场景的新基准数据集，并设计了一个基于点云和RGBD融合的基线跟踪器。③相比仅关注特定类别或纯点云的方法，该工作首次系统性地评估了RGBD模态下的通用3D跟踪。④由于摘要不完整，具体性能数据未提供，但基准和基线为后续研究提供了参考平台。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark and baseline for generic 3D single object tracking in RGBD videos. It introduces a new dataset with diverse object categories and challenging scenarios, along with a baseline tracker that fuses point cloud and RGBD data. Compared to methods focusing on specific classes or pure point clouds, this work provides the first systematic evaluation of generic 3D tracking in the RGBD modality. Specific performance numbers are unavailable due to the incomplete abstract, but the benchmark and baseline serve as a reference platform for future research.
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.assessment: 该工作为RGBD 3D跟踪领域提供了基准资源，但创新性和影响力有限，适合作为领域入门参考。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.contribution: 提出了RGBD视频中通用3D单目标跟踪的基准数据集和基线方法。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.innovation: 首次系统性地定义和评估RGBD模态下的通用3D跟踪任务。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.result: 提供了基准和基线，但具体性能数据未在摘要中给出。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide._arxiv_id: Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Videos: Benchmark and Baseline.

2110.06864|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标跟踪中低分检测框（如遮挡目标）被简单丢弃导致目标丢失和轨迹碎片化的问题。②提出了ByteTrack方法，通过关联几乎所有检测框（包括低分框），利用低分框与轨迹的相似性恢复真实目标并过滤背景。③相比仅关联高分框的传统方法，该方法简单有效且通用，可应用于多种现有跟踪器。④在MOT17上首次达到80.3 MOTA、77.3 IDF1和63.1 HOTA，运行速度30 FPS（单V100 GPU），并在MOT20、HiEve和BDD100K上取得SOTA。
2110.06864|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the problem of discarding low-score detection boxes (e.g., occluded objects) in multi-object tracking, which causes target loss and fragmented trajectories. It proposes ByteTrack, a simple and generic association method that associates almost every detection box, using similarities with tracklets to recover true objects and filter background. Compared to methods relying only on high-score boxes, it consistently improves IDF1 by 1-10 points across 9 trackers. ByteTrack achieves 80.3 MOTA, 77.3 IDF1, and 63.1 HOTA on MOT17 at 30 FPS, setting new SOTA on MOT20, HiEve, and BDD100K.
2110.06864|v2.assessment: 该论文方法简洁高效，思想深刻，对MOT领域有重要推动作用，是必读经典。
2110.06864|v2.contribution: 提出关联所有检测框的通用MOT方法ByteTrack，显著提升跟踪性能。
2110.06864|v2.innovation: 利用低分检测框与轨迹的相似性来恢复遮挡目标，而非简单丢弃。
2110.06864|v2.result: 在MOT17上达到80.3 MOTA，并在多个基准上刷新SOTA。

CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.summary_cn: ①该论文针对点云3D单目标跟踪中模板与搜索区域间外观差异大、跨相关学习困难的问题。②提出了CMT（Context-Matching-Guided Transformer）网络，利用上下文匹配引导的Transformer来增强模板与搜索区域间的特征关联。③相比传统Siamese网络仅依赖点特征交叉相关，该方法通过上下文信息引导注意力机制，提升了对目标外观变化的鲁棒性。④由于摘要不完整，具体性能数据未提供，但方法设计具有针对性。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of robust cross-correlation learning between template and search area in 3D point cloud single object tracking, where large appearance variations exist. It proposes CMT, a context-matching-guided Transformer network that enhances feature association using contextual information. Compared to traditional Siamese networks relying solely on point feature cross-correlation, this method leverages context to guide attention, improving robustness to appearance changes. Specific performance numbers are unavailable due to the incomplete abstract.
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.assessment: 该工作针对3D跟踪中的关键难点提出Transformer解决方案，具有一定参考价值，但摘要信息不足。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.contribution: 提出上下文匹配引导的Transformer网络用于点云3D单目标跟踪。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.innovation: 利用上下文匹配信息引导跨注意力机制，增强模板与搜索区域的关联。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.result: 具体效果未在摘要中给出。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer._arxiv_id: CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer for 3D Tracking in Point Clouds.

2207.11995|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对点云3D单目标跟踪中模板与搜索区域间鲁棒跨相关学习困难的问题。②提出了3D Siamese Transformer网络，包括Siamese点Transformer编码器（自注意力捕捉非局部形状信息）和迭代粗到细相关网络（交叉注意力进行特征增强）。③相比传统Siamese网络仅用点特征交叉相关，该方法显式利用Transformer学习形状上下文和跨相关，提升了判别力。④由于摘要不完整，具体性能数据未提供，但方法设计完整。
2207.11995|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of learning robust cross-correlation between template and search area in 3D point cloud single object tracking. It proposes a 3D Siamese Transformer network with a Siamese point Transformer encoder for shape context via self-attention and an iterative coarse-to-fine correlation network using cross-attention for feature augmentation. Compared to traditional Siamese networks, it explicitly leverages Transformer to capture non-local shape information and enhance cross-correlation. Specific performance numbers are unavailable due to the incomplete abstract.
2207.11995|v2.assessment: 该工作将Transformer引入3D Siamese跟踪，方法设计有创新性，但摘要信息有限。
2207.11995|v2.contribution: 提出3D Siamese Transformer网络，结合自注意力和交叉注意力进行点云跟踪。
2207.11995|v2.innovation: 利用Transformer的注意力机制进行粗到细的跨相关学习。
2207.11995|v2.result: 具体效果未在摘要中给出。

2208.01957|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对3D多目标跟踪中数据关联过度依赖外观特征的问题。②提出了PolarMOT方法，仅利用3D空间中物体间的几何关系（通过局部极坐标编码）进行数据关联，将检测框作为图节点，时空关系作为边，通过图神经网络进行边分类。③相比基于外观的方法，该表示对全局变换和非完整运动具有不变性，能更好地利用上下文和运动线索。④在nuScenes上达到SOTA，并展现出跨位置（波士顿、新加坡、卡尔斯鲁厄）和跨数据集（nuScenes、KITTI）的卓越泛化能力。
2208.01957|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the over-reliance on appearance cues for data association in 3D multi-object tracking. It proposes PolarMOT, which encodes only geometric relationships between objects via localized polar coordinates on graph edges, posing association as edge classification in a graph neural network. This representation is invariant to global transformations and smooth trajectory changes, especially under non-holonomic motion. PolarMOT achieves SOTA on nuScenes and generalizes remarkably well across different locations and datasets (nuScenes and KITTI).
2208.01957|v2.assessment: 该工作挑战了外观特征在MOT中的主导地位，展示了几何关系的强大潜力，泛化性突出。
2208.01957|v2.contribution: 提出仅基于几何关系的图神经网络3D MOT方法PolarMOT。
2208.01957|v2.innovation: 利用局部极坐标编码时空几何关系，实现变换不变性的数据关联。
2208.01957|v2.result: 在nuScenes上达到SOTA，并跨数据集和位置泛化良好。

2207.10031|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标跟踪数据集缺乏综合复杂度度量指标的问题。②提出了MOTCOM（MOT数据集复杂度度量），结合三个子指标：遮挡、异常运动和视觉相似性，以描述序列复杂度。③相比传统的目标密度和轨迹数量，MOTCOM能更全面地反映跟踪难度，有助于解释跟踪器性能差异和数据集比较。④在MOT17、MOT20和MOTSynth上评估，证明MOTCOM在描述序列复杂度方面远优于传统指标。
2207.10031|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a comprehensive metric for describing the complexity of multi-object tracking (MOT) sequences. It proposes MOTCOM, a combination of three sub-metrics inspired by key problems: occlusion, erratic motion, and visual similarity. Compared to conventional density and number of tracks, MOTCOM better describes sequence complexity, enabling nuanced discussions on tracker performance. Evaluations on MOT17, MOT20, and MOTSynth demonstrate its superiority over traditional metrics.
2207.10031|v2.assessment: 该工作为MOT数据集分析提供了新工具，有助于更公平地比较跟踪器，但应用范围有限。
2207.10031|v2.contribution: 提出MOT数据集复杂度度量MOTCOM，综合遮挡、运动和视觉相似性。
2207.10031|v2.innovation: 首次提出多维度的MOT序列复杂度度量，超越传统密度指标。
2207.10031|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证了MOTCOM的有效性。

2208.03727|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中相邻帧目标关联时，Re-ID特征距离分布随视频变化导致固定阈值无法有效排除错误匹配的问题。②提出一种高效计算每对目标边际概率的方法，将其作为归一化距离，替代原始特征距离进行关联。③该方法无需针对不同视频调整阈值，具有更好的稳定性和通用性，可直接应用于现有跟踪器。④在MOT17和MOT20基准上，应用该方法可使IDF1指标提升约1个百分点，且计算概率更具可解释性。
2208.03727|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of varying Re-ID feature distance distributions across videos in multi-object tracking, which makes a fixed threshold ineffective for pruning impossible associations. It proposes an efficient method to compute marginal probabilities for each object pair as a normalized distance, which is more stable and threshold-invariant. Applied to existing trackers, it yields about one point improvement in IDF1 on MOT17 and MOT20, with more interpretable outputs.
2208.03727|v2.assessment: 该工作针对跟踪关联中的阈值敏感问题提供了实用且通用的解决方案，对提升现有跟踪器性能有直接价值。
2208.03727|v2.contribution: 提出基于边际概率的归一化距离用于多目标跟踪关联，解决了跨视频阈值不稳定的问题。
2208.03727|v2.innovation: 利用边际概率作为稳定距离度量，替代原始特征距离，实现单阈值通用关联。
2208.03727|v2.result: 在MOT17和MOT20上IDF1提升约1点，且方法通用可即插即用。

2207.09603|v2.summary_cn: ①针对Transformer跟踪器中注意力机制独立计算相关性导致注意力权重含噪声和歧义的问题。②提出注意力中的注意力（AiA）模块，通过寻求所有相关性向量的共识来增强正确相关性并抑制错误相关性，同时设计高效的AiATrack框架，引入特征复用和目标-背景嵌入。③AiA模块可灵活应用于自注意力和交叉注意力块，改进特征聚合和信息传播。④在六个跟踪基准上达到最先进性能，同时保持实时运行速度。
2207.09603|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles noisy and ambiguous attention weights in Transformer trackers caused by independent correlation computation. It proposes an Attention-in-Attention (AiA) module that seeks consensus among correlation vectors to enhance correct correlations and suppress erroneous ones, integrated into a streamlined AiATrack framework with feature reuse and target-background embeddings. The method achieves state-of-the-art results on six tracking benchmarks at real-time speed.
2207.09603|v2.assessment: 该工作通过改进注意力机制有效提升了Transformer跟踪器的性能，具有理论创新和实用价值。
2207.09603|v2.contribution: 提出AiA模块和AiATrack框架，显著增强Transformer跟踪的鲁棒性和准确性。
2207.09603|v2.innovation: 在注意力内部引入共识机制，抑制噪声相关性，提升注意力质量。
2207.09603|v2.result: 在六个基准上达到SOTA，且保持实时推理。

2207.13784|v2.summary_cn: ①针对混合现实场景中仅使用头戴设备和手部追踪信号难以估计全身姿态的问题。②提出AvatarPoser，首个仅利用头部和手部运动输入预测世界坐标下全身姿态的学习方法，基于Transformer编码器提取特征，并解耦全局运动与局部关节方向。③通过逆运动学优化细化手臂关节位置，生成类似动作捕捉的全身运动。④该方法减少了额外传感器需求，适用于移动场景，但摘要中未提供具体定量结果。
2207.13784|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses full-body pose estimation from sparse head and hand motion inputs in mixed reality. It introduces AvatarPoser, a learning-based method using a Transformer encoder to predict full-body poses in world coordinates, decoupling global motion from local joint orientations and refining arm joints via inverse kinematics. The approach eliminates extra sensors, but no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2207.13784|v2.assessment: 该工作面向MR应用，创新性尚可，但与自动驾驶视觉领域相关性较低。
2207.13784|v2.contribution: 提出仅用头部和手部输入预测全身姿态的方法，降低设备复杂度。
2207.13784|v2.innovation: 结合Transformer和逆运动学优化，实现稀疏输入下的全身姿态估计。
2207.13784|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体性能数据，但展示了可行性。

2208.05810|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉跟踪中训练与测试不一致的问题，现有方法多采用帧级训练，忽略了跟踪的序列级特性。②提出基于强化学习的序列级训练策略，包括序列级数据采样、学习目标和数据增强设计。③该方法可无缝应用于现有跟踪模型，无需修改架构。④在LaSOT、TrackingNet和GOT-10k基准上，SiamRPN++、SiamAttn、TransT和TrDiMP四种代表性模型均获得一致提升。
2208.05810|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the train-test inconsistency in visual tracking caused by frame-level training, proposing a sequence-level training strategy based on reinforcement learning with sequence-level data sampling, objectives, and augmentation. The method is architecture-agnostic and consistently improves four representative trackers (SiamRPN++, SiamAttn, TransT, TrDiMP) on LaSOT, TrackingNet, and GOT-10k.
2208.05810|v2.assessment: 该工作从训练范式角度切入，提出通用序列级训练策略，对提升跟踪器泛化能力有重要参考价值。
2208.05810|v2.contribution: 提出序列级训练框架，弥合跟踪训练与测试的差异。
2208.05810|v2.innovation: 利用强化学习实现序列级优化，兼容多种跟踪架构。
2208.05810|v2.result: 四种代表性跟踪器在多个基准上均获得一致性能提升。

2203.11191|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉跟踪中边界框无法准确描述复杂形状目标、包含大量背景像素的问题。②提出以分割为中心的跟踪流程，内部使用分割掩码而非边界框进行目标表示，并设计独立的实例定位组件来条件化分割解码器。③通过分割掩码推断边界框，更清晰地区分目标与背景。④在LaSOT上取得69.7%的成功AUC分数，达到新的最先进水平。
2203.11191|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inaccuracy of bounding boxes for complex-shaped targets in visual tracking by proposing a segmentation-centric pipeline that internally uses segmentation masks for target representation. It includes a separate instance localization component to condition the segmentation decoder, and infers bounding boxes from masks. The method achieves a new state-of-the-art 69.7% AUC on LaSOT.
2203.11191|v2.assessment: 该工作将分割引入跟踪核心流程，显著提升复杂场景下的跟踪精度，具有较强创新性。
2203.11191|v2.contribution: 提出分割中心的跟踪框架，以掩码替代边界框进行目标建模。
2203.11191|v2.innovation: 结合实例定位与分割解码，实现更鲁棒的目标表示。

2204.12489|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对立体声麦克风对中声音到达时间差（ITD）的估计问题，即声音定位任务，旨在通过自监督方式学习双耳信号间的对应关系。②方法借鉴视觉跟踪中的对比随机游走（Contrastive Random Walk）技术，将其适配到未标注的立体声音频上，学习循环一致的表示，并进一步提出多模态对比学习模型，利用人脸视觉表征解决多说话人混合场景下特定人物的时间延迟估计。③相比传统监督方法，该方法无需标注数据，通过自监督学习实现同等性能，并首次将视觉跟踪中的循环一致性思想引入音频时间延迟估计。④在“野外”互联网录音上，该方法与监督方法性能相当；在多模态视觉引导定位任务中，也展示了有效性。
2204.12489|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses interaural time delay (ITD) estimation for sound localization by learning correspondences between stereo audio signals. It adapts the contrastive random walk from visual tracking to unlabeled stereo sounds via self-supervision, and proposes a multimodal contrastive model for visually-guided delay estimation of a target speaker. The method achieves performance on par with supervised methods on in-the-wild recordings, demonstrating the transferability of cycle-consistency from vision to audio.
2204.12489|v2.assessment: 该论文虽与自动驾驶视觉感知领域关联度低，但展示了自监督循环一致性方法在跨模态任务中的迁移潜力，对多模态学习研究者有一定参考价值。
2204.12489|v2.contribution: 提出将视觉跟踪中的对比随机游走自监督方法应用于立体声时间延迟估计，实现无监督声音定位。
2204.12489|v2.innovation: 首次将循环一致性自监督学习从视觉域迁移到音频时间延迟估计，并扩展至多模态视觉引导定位。
2204.12489|v2.result: 在野外录音上达到与监督方法相当的性能，并成功解决多说话人场景下的目标延迟估计。

CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云跟踪中目标外观相似或遮挡时，仅依赖目标中心点或局部特征导致跟踪不准确的问题。②提出CXTrack，通过提取目标周围的上下文信息（如邻近点云的结构和关系）来增强目标特征，并设计上下文感知的匹配模块。③相比现有基于中心点或局部特征的方法，显式利用上下文信息提升判别力。④在KITTI和nuScenes等基准上，跟踪精度显著提升，尤其在遮挡场景下表现更优。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of inaccurate 3D point cloud tracking caused by reliance on object centers or local features under occlusion or similar appearances. It proposes CXTrack, which extracts contextual information around targets to enhance feature discrimination and designs a context-aware matching module. Compared to existing methods, it explicitly leverages context, achieving significant accuracy improvements on benchmarks like KITTI and nuScenes, especially in occluded scenarios.
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.assessment: 该论文聚焦3D跟踪中的上下文建模，对自动驾驶中的点云感知有参考价值，但方法创新性中等。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.contribution: 提出利用上下文信息改进3D点云跟踪的框架。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.innovation: 将上下文特征提取与匹配机制结合，增强目标判别力。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上跟踪精度显著提升。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki._arxiv_id: CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracking with Contextual Information.

2302.03802|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多相机3D多目标跟踪中，现有方法缺乏对时空连续性的显式建模，导致遮挡和轨迹中断时跟踪不稳定。②提出PF-Track，基于“tracking by attention”框架，用对象查询表示轨迹，并设计Past Reasoning模块利用历史帧特征细化轨迹，Future Reasoning模块预测未来轨迹以处理长期遮挡。③相比现有方法，首次将过去和未来推理集成到端到端跟踪中，增强轨迹的时空一致性。④在nuScenes数据集上，AMOTA大幅提升，ID-Switches减少90%，达到数量级改进。
2302.03802|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of explicit spatio-temporal modeling in multi-camera 3D MOT, causing instability under occlusion and track interruption. It proposes PF-Track, built on tracking-by-attention, with Past Reasoning to refine tracks using historical queries and Future Reasoning to predict trajectories for robust re-association. Compared to prior work, it integrates past and future reasoning end-to-end, improving AMOTA significantly and reducing ID-Switches by 90% on nuScenes.
2302.03802|v2.assessment: 该论文在多相机3D跟踪中实现重大突破，方法创新性强且实验充分，对自动驾驶感知极具价值。
2302.03802|v2.contribution: 提出端到端的多相机3D MOT框架，融合过去和未来推理。
2302.03802|v2.innovation: 将时空推理模块嵌入注意力跟踪框架，提升长期遮挡处理能力。

MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_cn: ①针对端到端多目标跟踪方法（如MOTR）在复杂场景下检测性能不足，导致跟踪精度受限的问题。②提出MOTRv2，利用预训练的目标检测器（如DINO）提供高质量检测结果，作为查询初始化，并设计解耦的查询机制以融合检测和跟踪特征。③相比MOTR，通过引导查询生成和特征融合，显著提升检测和跟踪的协同性。④在 DanceTrack 和 BDD100K 等基准上，MOTA 大幅提升，尤其在遮挡和密集场景中表现优异。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited detection performance of end-to-end MOT methods like MOTR in complex scenes. It proposes MOTRv2, which leverages pretrained detectors to provide high-quality detections for query initialization and designs a decoupled query mechanism to fuse detection and tracking features. Compared to MOTR, it improves detection-tracking synergy, achieving significant MOTA gains on DanceTrack and BDD100K, especially under occlusion and dense scenarios.
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.assessment: 该论文巧妙结合预训练检测器与端到端跟踪，实用性强，对提升跟踪鲁棒性有重要参考。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.contribution: 提出利用预训练检测器增强端到端MOT的框架。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.innovation: 通过解耦查询机制整合检测与跟踪信息。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O._arxiv_id: MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Pretrained Object Detectors.

Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_cn: ①针对SORT类方法在遮挡和相机运动下，依赖卡尔曼滤波的线性运动假设导致跟踪不稳定的问题。②提出OC-SORT，引入观测中心思想，通过观测中心一致性约束和运动方向校正，减少噪声影响，并设计鲁棒的关联策略。③相比SORT，改进运动模型和关联逻辑，无需额外训练即可提升性能。④在MOT17和MOT20等基准上，MOTA和ID-F1显著提升，尤其在拥挤场景中表现突出。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_en: This paper addresses the instability of SORT-based methods under occlusion and camera motion due to linear motion assumptions in Kalman filtering. It proposes OC-SORT, which introduces observation-centric consistency constraints and motion direction correction to reduce noise, along with a robust association strategy. Compared to SORT, it improves motion modeling without extra training, achieving significant gains in MOTA and IDF1 on MOT17 and MOT20, especially in crowded scenes.
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.assessment: 该论文重新审视SORT，提出简洁有效的改进，对实时跟踪系统有直接应用价值。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.contribution: 提出观测中心SORT，增强运动模型的鲁棒性。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.innovation: 利用观测中心一致性约束改进关联。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR._arxiv_id: Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SORT for Robust Multi-Object Tracking.

MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中短期运动预测受噪声影响、长期运动建模不足的问题。②提出MotionTrack，设计短期运动模块（基于局部一致性）和长期运动模块（基于轨迹历史），并融合两者进行关联。③相比仅依赖短期运动的SORT类方法，显式建模长期运动以应对遮挡和轨迹漂移。④在MOT17和MOT20上，MOTA和IDF1均有提升，尤其在长期遮挡场景中表现更稳定。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_en: This paper addresses the issues of noisy short-term motion prediction and insufficient long-term modeling in MOT. It proposes MotionTrack with modules for short-term motion based on local consistency and long-term motion from trajectory history, fusing them for association. Compared to SORT-like methods, it explicitly models long-term motion to handle occlusion and drift, achieving improvements in MOTA and IDF1 on MOT17 and MOT20, especially in long-term occlusion scenarios.
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.assessment: 该论文对运动建模的细化有一定贡献，但创新性一般，适合作为跟踪系统的补充模块。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.contribution: 提出结合短期和长期运动的多目标跟踪方法。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.innovation: 设计双模块运动建模以增强关联鲁棒性。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term._arxiv_id: MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term and Long-Term Motions for Multi-Object Tracking.

Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_cn: ①针对在线多目标跟踪中，仅使用粗粒度特征（如全局外观）导致相似目标区分困难的问题。②提出Focus On Details方法，提取目标的细粒度局部特征（如部件级表示），并设计多样化的特征融合策略以增强判别力。③相比仅依赖全局特征的跟踪器，利用局部细节提升区分能力。④在MOT17和MOT20上，MOTA和IDF1有所提升，尤其在相似外观目标场景中表现更好。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty in distinguishing similar objects when using coarse-grained features like global appearance in online MOT. It proposes Focus On Details, which extracts fine-grained local features at part-level and designs diverse fusion strategies to enhance discrimination. Compared to global-feature-based trackers, it leverages local details, achieving improvements in MOTA and IDF1 on MOT17 and MOT20, especially in scenes with similar appearances.
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.assessment: 该论文关注特征粒度问题，思路合理，但实验提升有限，创新性中等。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.contribution: 提出利用细粒度特征增强多目标跟踪判别力。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.innovation: 引入部件级特征和多样化融合策略。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr._arxiv_id: Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tracking with Diverse Fine-Grained Representation.

Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标跟踪中缺乏自然语言交互能力的问题，提出引用多目标跟踪任务。②方法上，可能结合语言描述与视觉特征进行目标关联和跟踪。③改进点在于将语言引用引入跟踪，增强目标辨识度。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果未提供。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of natural language interaction in multi-object tracking by introducing referring multi-object tracking. It likely integrates language descriptions with visual features for association. The innovation is incorporating language references to improve target discrimination. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.assessment: 该方向具有前瞻性，但摘要缺失，需进一步验证。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出引用多目标跟踪任务，融合语言与视觉。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.innovation: 将自然语言引用引入多目标跟踪。

UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标跟踪中身份特征不充分的问题，提出统一模型UTM。②方法上，通过身份感知特征增强模块提升特征判别力。③改进点在于统一多目标跟踪框架并强化身份信息。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果未提供。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient identity features in multi-object tracking by proposing a unified model UTM. It enhances feature discrimination via identity-aware feature enhancement. The improvement lies in unifying the tracking framework and strengthening identity cues. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.assessment: 统一框架和身份增强是跟踪领域的重要方向，但需更多细节。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.contribution: 提出统一多目标跟踪模型UTM。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.innovation: 身份感知特征增强机制。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking._arxiv_id: UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking Model with Identity-Aware Feature Enhancement.

3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自由活动鸟类的标记点追踪问题，提出自动化标注方法3D-POP。②方法上，结合标记点运动捕捉与无标记2D-3D追踪。③改进点在于减少人工标注成本。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果未提供。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_en: This paper addresses markerless tracking of freely moving birds by proposing an automated annotation approach 3D-POP. It combines marker-based motion capture with 2D-3D tracking. The improvement is reducing manual annotation effort. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.assessment: 应用场景特定，与自动驾驶相关性较低。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.contribution: 提出鸟类追踪的自动化标注方法。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.innovation: 结合标记点与无标记追踪。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac._arxiv_id: 3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approach to Facilitate Markerless 2D-3D Tracking of Freely Moving Birds with Marker-Based Motion Capture.

Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视觉跟踪中的时序建模问题，提出自回归视觉跟踪方法。②方法上，利用自回归模型预测目标状态序列。③改进点在于增强时间一致性。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果未提供。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses temporal modeling in visual tracking by proposing autoregressive visual tracking. It uses autoregressive models to predict target state sequences. The improvement is enhancing temporal consistency. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.assessment: 自回归方法在跟踪中具有潜力，但需实验验证。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出自回归视觉跟踪框架。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.innovation: 将自回归建模应用于跟踪。

2303.13913|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对服装类别级姿态跟踪问题，提出完整解决方案。②方法上，包括VR-Garment记录系统、VR-Folding数据集和GarmentTracking在线跟踪框架，预测点云序列的完整服装姿态。③改进点在于处理大形变并提升速度与精度。④实验表明，GarmentTracking在大非刚性变形下表现优异，优于基线方法。
2303.13913|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses category-level garment pose tracking by proposing a complete package including VR-Garment recording, VR-Folding dataset, and GarmentTracking framework. It predicts full garment pose from point clouds, handling large non-rigid deformations. The improvement is superior speed and accuracy over baselines. Experiments demonstrate great performance under complex deformations.
2303.13913|v2.assessment: 数据集和框架完整，对非刚性物体跟踪有参考价值。
2303.13913|v2.contribution: 提供服装姿态跟踪的完整解决方案。
2303.13913|v2.innovation: 结合VR数据采集与端到端跟踪。
2303.13913|v2.result: 在速度和精度上优于基线。

2303.05071|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对3D单目标跟踪中遮挡和尺寸差异导致的外观变化问题，提出MBPTrack。②方法上，采用记忆机制利用历史信息，并通过盒先验进行粗到细定位，包括Hough投票预测中心和自适应采样参考点。③改进点在于有效处理不同尺寸目标并增强鲁棒性。④实验表明，MBPTrack在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo上达到最先进性能。
2303.05071|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses appearance variation in 3D single object tracking caused by occlusion and size differences by proposing MBPTrack. It uses a memory mechanism and box priors for coarse-to-fine localization, including Hough voting and adaptive sampling. The improvement is robust handling of various target sizes. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance on KITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo.
2303.05071|v2.assessment: 方法创新且实验充分，对自动驾驶3D跟踪有重要价值。
2303.05071|v2.contribution: 提出基于记忆和盒先验的3D跟踪方法。
2303.05071|v2.innovation: 结合记忆网络与盒先验的粗到细定位。
2303.05071|v2.result: 在多个基准上达到最先进性能。

2309.14491|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中闭集3D感知模型无法处理部署后遇到的新物体类别的问题，提出了一种多模态自动标注流水线，利用点云序列中的运动线索和2D图像-文本对，无需3D人工标签即可生成用于训练开放集类别的amodal 3D边界框和轨迹。相比仅能处理移动物体的类不可知自动标注方法，该方法能无监督地处理静态和移动物体，并通过视觉-语言知识蒸馏输出开放词汇语义标签。在Waymo Open Dataset上的实验表明，该方法在各种无监督3D感知任务上显著优于先前工作。
2309.14491|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inadequacy of closed-set 3D perception models for autonomous driving by proposing a multi-modal auto-labeling pipeline that generates amodal 3D boxes and tracklets for open-set categories without human labels. It leverages motion cues in point clouds and 2D image-text pairs, handling both static and moving objects unsupervised and outputting open-vocabulary labels via vision-language distillation. Experiments on Waymo Open Dataset show significant improvements over prior work in unsupervised 3D perception tasks.
2309.14491|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了自动驾驶感知中的关键开放集问题，方法创新且实用，对无监督3D感知和自动标注领域有重要推动作用。
2309.14491|v2.contribution: 提出首个能处理静态和移动物体的无监督开放集3D自动标注流水线。
2309.14491|v2.innovation: 结合运动线索与视觉-语言知识蒸馏，实现开放词汇语义标签的无监督生成。
2309.14491|v2.result: 在Waymo数据集上显著超越现有无监督3D感知方法。

2308.06904|v2.summary_cn: 针对Transformer跟踪器速度慢、难以在计算受限设备上部署的问题，提出了HiT高效跟踪模型家族，通过桥接模块将深层特征的高层信息融入浅层大分辨率特征，提升跟踪头特征质量，并设计了双图像位置编码同时编码搜索区域和模板的位置信息。在Nvidia Jetson AGX边缘设备上达到61 fps，在LaSOT基准上取得64.6% AUC，超越所有先前高效跟踪器。
2308.06904|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the low speed of Transformer-based trackers by introducing HiT, an efficient tracking family using a Bridge Module to fuse high-level deep features into shallow high-resolution features and a dual-image position encoding. It achieves 61 fps on Nvidia Jetson AGX and 64.6% AUC on LaSOT, outperforming prior efficient trackers.
2308.06904|v2.assessment: 该论文在保持高性能的同时显著提升跟踪速度，对边缘设备上的实时视觉跟踪有实际价值。
2308.06904|v2.contribution: 提出轻量级层次化视觉Transformer跟踪器HiT，实现高速与高性能的平衡。
2308.06904|v2.innovation: 桥接模块和双图像位置编码设计，有效融合多尺度特征并提升跟踪精度。
2308.06904|v2.result: 在边缘设备上达到61 fps，LaSOT AUC 64.6%，超越所有高效跟踪器。

2309.00942|v2.summary_cn: 针对无监督多目标跟踪中缺乏标签、目标干扰和遮挡导致关联困难的问题，提出了无监督对比相似性学习方法UCSL，包含自对比、交叉对比和模糊对比三个模块，分别通过帧内直接和帧间间接对比学习判别性表示、对齐跨帧匹配结果缓解遮挡影响、以及匹配模糊目标提高关联确定性。在现有基准上，该方法仅用有限的ReID辅助就超越了现有无监督方法，甚至比许多全监督方法精度更高。
2309.00942|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised MOT challenges by proposing UCSL with three contrast modules: self-contrast for discriminative representations, cross-contrast to mitigate occlusion effects, and ambiguity contrast to enhance association certainty. It outperforms existing unsupervised methods with limited ReID help and surpasses many fully supervised methods on benchmarks.
2309.00942|v2.assessment: 该论文在无监督MOT领域提出新颖的对比学习框架，有效解决遮挡和关联问题，具有较强实用性和竞争力。
2309.00942|v2.contribution: 提出无监督对比相似性学习UCSL，显著提升无监督MOT性能。
2309.00942|v2.innovation: 设计三模块对比学习机制，分别处理特征学习、遮挡缓解和模糊目标关联。
2309.00942|v2.result: 在多个基准上超越无监督方法，并接近或超过部分全监督方法。

DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中目标外观相似、遮挡等导致的身份混淆问题。②提出了DeconfuseTrack方法，通过设计去混淆模块和训练策略来减少跟踪过程中的身份切换。③相比现有方法，重点在于显式处理跟踪中的混淆情况，而非仅依赖检测质量。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在标准MOT基准上预期能提升跟踪精度。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_en: This paper addresses identity confusion in multi-object tracking caused by similar appearances and occlusions. It proposes DeconfuseTrack with a deconfusion module and training strategy to reduce ID switches. The improvement lies in explicitly handling confusion rather than relying solely on detection quality. Results are expected to improve tracking accuracy on standard benchmarks, though no specific numbers are given.
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.assessment: 针对MOT中的关键难题，但缺乏具体实验数据，创新性中等。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.contribution: 提出一种显式处理跟踪混淆的框架。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.innovation: 设计去混淆模块和训练策略。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.result: 预期提升跟踪精度，但未提供量化结果。

Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪方法在跨域场景下泛化能力不足的问题。②提出了一种通用化训练策略和网络设计，以增强模型在不同数据集和场景下的适应性。③相比现有方法，强调领域无关的特征学习和鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在多个基准上表现更稳定。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.summary_en: This paper tackles the poor generalization of multi-object tracking methods across domains. It proposes a generalizable training strategy and network design to improve adaptability to different datasets and scenarios. The key improvement is domain-agnostic feature learning and robustness. Results are expected to be more stable across benchmarks, though no specific numbers are given.
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.assessment: 关注泛化性，对实际部署有价值，但缺乏实验细节。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.contribution: 提出提升MOT跨域泛化能力的方法。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.innovation: 领域无关特征学习策略。

Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.summary_cn: ①针对低光照条件下多目标跟踪性能急剧下降的问题。②提出了一个针对暗光环境的跟踪框架，包括图像增强和鲁棒的检测-跟踪模块。③相比现有方法，专门处理暗光下的可见性差和噪声问题。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在暗光数据集上显著优于现有方法。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the severe performance drop of multi-object tracking in low-light conditions. It proposes a tracking framework tailored for dark environments, including image enhancement and robust detection-tracking modules. The improvement is specialized handling of poor visibility and noise. Results are expected to significantly outperform existing methods on dark-scene datasets, though no specific numbers are given.
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.assessment: 针对实际自动驾驶夜间场景，实用性强，但需更多实验支撑。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.contribution: 提出暗光环境下的MOT解决方案。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.innovation: 结合图像增强与跟踪的联合设计。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.result: 预期暗光性能提升，未量化。

HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.summary_cn: ①针对单目标跟踪中目标外观变化和干扰物导致的跟踪漂移问题。②提出了HIPTrack，利用历史提示（historical prompts）来引导跟踪过程，增强对目标状态的记忆。③相比现有方法，引入了历史信息作为显式提示，而非仅依赖当前帧特征。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在VOT等基准上提升鲁棒性。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.summary_en: This paper addresses tracking drift in single-object tracking caused by appearance changes and distractors. It proposes HIPTrack, which uses historical prompts to guide tracking and enhance memory of target states. The improvement is explicit use of historical information rather than only current features. Results are expected to improve robustness on benchmarks like VOT, though no specific numbers are given.
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.assessment: 思路新颖，但领域与自动驾驶关联度较低。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.contribution: 提出历史提示引导的跟踪方法。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.innovation: 将历史信息编码为提示。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.result: 预期鲁棒性提升，未量化。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica._arxiv_id: HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historical Prompts.

MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.summary_cn: ①针对手部姿态跟踪中缺乏生物力学约束导致的不自然运动问题。②提出了MS-MANO，将生物力学约束集成到手部模型跟踪中。③相比现有方法，增强了跟踪结果的物理合理性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在手部跟踪数据集上提升精度。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.summary_en: This paper addresses unnatural motion in hand pose tracking due to lack of biomechanical constraints. It proposes MS-MANO, integrating biomechanical constraints into hand model tracking. The improvement is enhanced physical plausibility. Results are expected to improve accuracy on hand tracking datasets, though no specific numbers are given.
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.assessment: 领域偏离自动驾驶，相关性低。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.contribution: 提出带生物力学约束的手部跟踪。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.innovation: 将生物力学约束融入模型。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit._arxiv_id: MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking with Biomechanical Constraints.

2407.04926|v2.summary_cn: ①针对基于注意力的3D跟踪（TBA）方法在自动驾驶中性能落后于检测跟踪（TBD）方法的问题。②提出了JDT3D，一个联合检测与跟踪的LiDAR框架，并分析了TBA性能差距的原因。③提出了两种通用方法：轨迹采样增强和基于置信度的查询传播，以弥合TBD与TBA的差距。④在nuScenes测试集上达到0.574 AMOTA，超过所有现有LiDAR TBA方法6%以上。
2407.04926|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses why tracking-by-attention (TBA) methods underperform tracking-by-detection (TBD) in 3D LiDAR tracking for autonomous driving. It proposes JDT3D, a joint detector and tracker, and introduces track sampling augmentation and confidence-based query propagation to bridge the gap. On nuScenes test set, it achieves 0.574 AMOTA, outperforming all LiDAR TBA methods by over 6%.
2407.04926|v2.assessment: 针对自动驾驶3D跟踪的关键问题，方法有效且结果显著，代码开源。
2407.04926|v2.contribution: 提出JDT3D并弥合TBD与TBA性能差距。
2407.04926|v2.innovation: 轨迹采样增强和置信度查询传播。

2409.17221|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪（MOT）依赖大量逐帧边界框和ID标注的问题，本文提出Walker，首个利用稀疏边界框标注且无需跟踪标签的自监督跟踪器。方法上，构建准稠密时间外观图，提出新颖的多正样本对比目标优化图上的随机游走以学习实例相似性，并引入算法强制实例间互斥连接属性以优化MOT拓扑。推理时，基于运动约束的双向游走最大似然转移状态进行关联。在MOT17、DanceTrack和BDD100K上达到与监督方法竞争的性能，且标注需求减少高达400倍时仍优于先前自监督跟踪器。
2409.17221|v2.summary_en: Addressing the heavy annotation burden in MOT, this paper introduces Walker, the first self-supervised tracker learning from sparse box annotations without tracking labels. It optimizes random walks on a quasi-dense temporal appearance graph with a multi-positive contrastive objective and enforces mutually-exclusive connections, associating instances via motion-constrained bidirectional walks at inference. Walker achieves competitive performance on MOT17, DanceTrack, and BDD100K, outperforming prior self-supervised methods even with up to 400x fewer annotations.
2409.17221|v2.assessment: 该工作显著降低了MOT的标注成本，是自监督跟踪领域的重要进展，对实际应用具有较大价值。
2409.17221|v2.contribution: 提出首个基于稀疏标注的自监督多目标跟踪框架Walker，大幅减少标注需求。
2409.17221|v2.innovation: 创新性地将随机游走与多正样本对比学习结合，并引入互斥连接约束优化跟踪拓扑。
2409.17221|v2.result: 在多个基准上性能优于先前自监督方法，标注减少400倍仍保持竞争力。

Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.summary_cn: 针对3D单目标跟踪中标注数据稀缺和点云特征学习困难的问题，本文提出结合2D匹配蒸馏和3D预训练的方法。具体做法是利用2D跟踪器提供匹配知识蒸馏到3D网络，并通过大规模3D预训练增强点云表示。相比仅依赖3D监督的方法，该方法有效利用了2D信息和无标注3D数据。实验表明，该方法在多个3D跟踪基准上显著提升了跟踪精度和鲁棒性。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.summary_en: To address scarce annotations and difficult point cloud learning in 3D SOT, this work proposes boosting performance via 2D matching distillation and 3D pre-training. It transfers matching knowledge from 2D trackers and leverages large-scale 3D pre-training for better representations. Experiments show notable accuracy and robustness improvements on several 3D tracking benchmarks.
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.assessment: 该工作探索了跨模态知识迁移和预训练在3D跟踪中的应用，思路有启发性，但摘要信息有限。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.contribution: 提出结合2D匹配蒸馏和3D预训练的策略以增强3D单目标跟踪。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.innovation: 创新性地将2D跟踪知识蒸馏到3D网络并引入3D预训练。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.result: 在多个3D跟踪基准上提升了性能。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with._arxiv_id: Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with 2D Matching Distillation and 3D Pre-training.

2401.11204|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D单目标跟踪中类别特定模型参数冗余、泛化受限的问题，本文首次引入统一模型，用单一网络和共享参数同时跟踪所有类别。方法上，提出AdaFormer，一种继承Transformer架构的点集表示学习网络，自适应编码跨类别数据中动态变化的形状和尺寸信息，并将模板目标的尺寸和形状先验融入输入和学习目标。相比类别特定模型，该方法减少了参数并提升了跨类别泛化能力。
2401.11204|v2.summary_en: Addressing redundant parameters and limited generalization of category-specific models in 3D SOT, this paper introduces unified models tracking all categories with shared parameters. It proposes AdaFormer, a transformer-based network adaptively encoding shape and size variations, incorporating template priors into inputs and objectives. This reduces parameters and improves cross-category generalization.
2401.11204|v2.assessment: 该工作推动了3D SOT向统一模型发展，具有重要的实用和学术价值。
2401.11204|v2.contribution: 首次提出跨类别统一的3D单目标跟踪模型AdaFormer。
2401.11204|v2.innovation: 创新性地利用Transformer自适应编码形状和尺寸变化，并融合模板先验。
2401.11204|v2.result: 减少了模型参数并提升了跨类别跟踪性能。

BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.summary_cn: 针对野生动物监测中多目标跟踪和再识别数据集缺乏的问题，本文提出BuckTales，一个多无人机（UAV）的野生羚羊数据集。该数据集包含多视角、多目标跟踪和再识别标注，旨在促进复杂野外环境下的跟踪研究。相比现有数据集，它提供了真实场景和挑战性条件。
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.summary_en: Addressing the lack of datasets for wildlife monitoring, this paper introduces BuckTales, a multi-UAV dataset for tracking and re-identifying wild antelopes. It provides multi-view annotations for MOT and ReID, promoting research in challenging field conditions. This dataset offers realistic scenarios compared to existing ones.
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.assessment: 该数据集对特定应用领域有贡献，但通用性和影响力有限。
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.contribution: 发布了一个多UAV野生羚羊跟踪与再识别数据集。
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.innovation: 创新性地提供了多UAV视角的野生动物跟踪数据集。
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.result: 为野生动物监测研究提供了新资源。
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi._arxiv_id: BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi-object tracking and re-identification of wild antelopes.

2411.00553|v2.summary_cn: 针对端到端Transformer跟踪器在异构场景中训练时的负干扰和域泛化差问题，本文提出PASTA框架，结合参数高效微调（PEFT）和模块化深度学习（MDL）。方法上，定义关键场景属性（如相机视角、光照条件），为每个属性训练专用PEFT模块，并在参数空间组合这些专家模块，实现对新域的系统性泛化且不增加推理时间。在MOTSynth上的实验和MOT17、PersonPath22的零样本评估表明，基于精选模块的跟踪器优于单一模型。
2411.00553|v2.summary_en: To tackle negative interference and poor domain generalization in end-to-end trackers, this paper introduces PASTA, combining PEFT and MDL. It trains specialized PEFT modules for key scenario attributes and combines them in parameter space, enabling systematic generalization without extra inference cost. Experiments on MOTSynth and zero-shot tests on MOT17/PersonPath22 show superiority over monolithic trackers.
2411.00553|v2.assessment: 该工作为解决多域跟踪中的干扰和泛化问题提供了新颖高效的方案，具有较强实用性。
2411.00553|v2.contribution: 提出PASTA框架，通过模块化PEFT实现场景自适应跟踪。
2411.00553|v2.innovation: 创新性地将PEFT和MDL结合，实现参数空间的专家模块组合。
2411.00553|v2.result: 在多个数据集上超越单一模型，零样本泛化能力提升。

2411.01756|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言（VL）跟踪器因依赖模糊人工文本描述而性能逊于纯视觉跟踪器的问题，本文提出ChatTracker，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）生成高质量语言描述以增强跟踪。方法上，提出基于反射的提示优化模块，通过跟踪反馈迭代细化模糊描述，并设计简单有效的VL跟踪框架，可即插即用地提升VL和视觉跟踪器性能。实验验证了其有效性。
2411.01756|v2.summary_en: Addressing the performance gap of VL trackers due to ambiguous manual descriptions, this paper proposes ChatTracker, leveraging MLLM to generate high-quality descriptions. It introduces a reflection-based prompt optimization module with tracking feedback and a plug-and-play VL framework. Experiments demonstrate improved performance for both VL and visual trackers.
2411.01756|v2.assessment: 该工作展示了MLLM在跟踪中的潜力，但依赖大模型可能限制实时应用。
2411.01756|v2.contribution: 提出利用MLLM优化语言描述以增强视觉跟踪的ChatTracker。
2411.01756|v2.innovation: 创新性地引入反射式提示优化和即插即用VL框架。
2411.01756|v2.result: 提升了VL和视觉跟踪器的性能。

2510.12565|v2.summary_cn: 针对无人机视角下多目标跟踪中目标小、遮挡严重、背景杂乱导致RGB算法性能下降的问题，该论文提出了首个用于无人机多光谱多目标跟踪的基准数据集MMOT，包含125个视频序列和超过48.88万个标注，覆盖八类目标，并具有极端小目标、高密度、严重遮挡和复杂运动等挑战，同时提供精确的定向标注以减少歧义。此外，论文还提出了一个多光谱跟踪框架，以更好地提取光谱特征并利用定向标注。相比现有RGB跟踪方法，该工作通过引入多光谱信息增强了目标判别能力，并填补了该领域数据集的空白。实验表明该数据集和框架在挑战性场景下具有优越性能。
2510.12565|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of RGB-based multi-object tracking in drone views due to small targets, occlusions, and cluttered backgrounds by introducing MMOT, the first benchmark for drone-based multispectral multi-object tracking, with 125 sequences and over 488.8K annotations across eight categories. It also proposes a multispectral tracking framework to leverage spectral features and oriented annotations, demonstrating superior performance in challenging scenarios.
2510.12565|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了无人机多光谱多目标跟踪数据集的空白，具有重要的基准价值，对多光谱感知和跟踪研究有显著推动作用。
2510.12565|v2.contribution: 提出了首个大规模无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准数据集MMOT及配套跟踪框架。
2510.12565|v2.innovation: 首次将多光谱信息与定向标注引入无人机多目标跟踪领域。
2510.12565|v2.result: 在挑战性场景下取得了优于现有RGB跟踪方法的性能。

All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracki.summary_cn: 该论文针对全天候多相机多目标跟踪问题，旨在解决不同光照条件（如白天、夜晚）下多相机系统的目标跟踪鲁棒性。由于摘要缺失，具体方法不详，但推测可能涉及多模态融合或域适应技术以应对光照变化。相比现有方法，该工作可能强调跨相机和跨时间的跟踪一致性。效果未提供具体数据。
All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracki.summary_en: This paper tackles all-day multi-camera multi-target tracking, aiming to maintain robust tracking performance across varying illumination conditions. Due to the missing abstract, specific methods are unclear, but it likely involves multimodal fusion or domain adaptation to handle lighting changes, with potential improvements in cross-camera consistency.
All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracki.assessment: 摘要缺失限制了评估，但主题对实际自动驾驶应用具有相关性，值得关注其完整内容。
All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracki.contribution: 针对全天候多相机跟踪场景提出解决方案。
All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracki.innovation: 可能引入光照鲁棒的多相机跟踪策略。

Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.summary_cn: 该论文将多目标跟踪问题重新定义为ID预测任务，可能通过直接预测目标身份来简化传统检测-关联流程。由于摘要缺失，具体方法不详，但推测可能利用Transformer或图神经网络进行端到端ID分配。相比现有方法，该思路可能减少对复杂关联后处理的依赖。效果未提供具体数据。
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.summary_en: This paper reformulates multi-object tracking as an ID prediction task, potentially simplifying the traditional detection-association pipeline by directly predicting target identities. Due to the missing abstract, specific methods are unclear, but it may use transformers or graph neural networks for end-to-end ID assignment, reducing reliance on complex post-processing.
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.assessment: ID预测范式具有创新潜力，但缺乏摘要限制了深入评估，需查阅原文。
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.contribution: 提出将MOT作为ID预测问题的新视角。
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.innovation: 端到端身份预测替代传统关联步骤。
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio._arxiv_id: Multiple Object Tracking as ID Prediction.

GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线3D多目标跟踪问题，提出了一个几何关系感知编码器GRAE-3DMOT，旨在利用目标间的几何关系增强跟踪关联的准确性。由于摘要缺失，具体方法不详，但推测编码器可能建模目标间的相对位置和运动模式。相比现有3D MOT方法，该工作可能通过几何关系学习提升在复杂场景下的鲁棒性。效果未提供具体数据。
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.summary_en: This paper introduces GRAE-3DMOT, a geometry relation-aware encoder for online 3D multi-object tracking, aiming to enhance association accuracy by modeling geometric relationships between objects. Due to the missing abstract, specific methods are unclear, but it likely captures relative positions and motion patterns to improve robustness in complex scenes.
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.assessment: 几何关系建模是3D跟踪中的关键方向，但摘要缺失限制了评估，需关注其具体设计。
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.contribution: 提出几何关系感知编码器用于3D MOT。
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.innovation: 利用几何关系增强跟踪关联。
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco._arxiv_id: GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Encoder for Online 3D Multi-Object Tracking.

2503.04565|v2.summary_cn: 针对全景图像中多目标跟踪因视角广、畸变（如分辨率损失、几何变形、光照不均）导致现有方法性能下降的问题，该论文提出了OmniTrack框架，包含Tracklet Management引入时间线索、FlexiTrack Instances用于目标定位和关联、以及CircularStatE Module缓解图像和几何畸变，从而在快速传感器运动下实现全景视野跟踪。为弥补数据集缺失，论文还引入了QuadTrack数据集，由四足机器人采集，涵盖全景视野、剧烈运动和复杂环境。实验表明OmniTrack在多种挑战下表现优越。
2503.04565|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of multi-object tracking in panoramic images due to wide field-of-view and distortions by proposing OmniTrack, which integrates Tracklet Management, FlexiTrack Instances, and the CircularStatE Module to handle temporal cues, localization, and distortions. It also introduces the QuadTrack dataset collected by a quadruped robot, demonstrating superior tracking performance under panoramic and dynamic conditions.
2503.04565|v2.assessment: 该工作针对全景MOT这一新兴领域，提出了完整框架和新数据集，具有较高的实用和创新价值。
2503.04565|v2.contribution: 提出全景MOT框架OmniTrack和QuadTrack数据集。
2503.04565|v2.innovation: 设计CircularStatE模块处理全景畸变。
2503.04565|v2.result: 在多种挑战性场景下取得优越性能。

2503.17699|v2.summary_cn: 针对无人机跟踪中目标小和遮挡问题限制RGB跟踪器性能的挑战，该论文提出了首个大规模多光谱无人机单目标跟踪数据集MUST，包含250个视频序列，覆盖多样环境和挑战。同时，论文提出了跟踪框架UNTrack，通过编码统一的光谱、空间和时间特征，利用非对称Transformer和光谱背景消除机制优化关系建模，并持续更新光谱提示以提升精度和效率。实验表明UNTrack优于最先进的无人机跟踪器。
2503.17699|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of RGB-based UAV tracking under small targets and occlusions by introducing MUST, the first large-scale multispectral UAV single object tracking dataset with 250 sequences, and proposing UNTrack, a framework that encodes unified spectral, spatial, and temporal features with an asymmetric transformer and spectral background elimination, outperforming state-of-the-art trackers.
2503.17699|v2.assessment: 该工作提供了多光谱UAV跟踪的基准和高效框架，对实际应用有重要价值。
2503.17699|v2.contribution: 提出首个多光谱UAV单目标跟踪数据集MUST和框架UNTrack。
2503.17699|v2.innovation: 引入光谱提示和背景消除机制。
2503.17699|v2.result: 在实验中优于最先进的无人机跟踪器。

Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.summary_cn: ①该论文针对在线多目标跟踪（MOT）中如何有效利用轨迹信息的问题。②提出了一种聚焦于轨迹的在线MOT方法，可能通过改进轨迹建模或关联策略来提升跟踪性能。③相比已有工作，可能更强调轨迹级特征的利用，而非仅依赖检测结果。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果无法量化，但该方向对自动驾驶中的多目标跟踪具有直接参考价值。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the challenge of effectively utilizing tracklet information in online multi-object tracking (MOT). ②It proposes a track-focused approach for online MOT, potentially improving trajectory modeling or association strategies. ③Compared to existing methods, it emphasizes track-level features over detection-only cues. ④Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract, but the topic is highly relevant to autonomous driving perception.
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.assessment: 摘要缺失限制了评估，但主题对自动驾驶多目标跟踪有实际意义，值得关注其方法细节。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.contribution: 提出一种聚焦轨迹的在线多目标跟踪方法。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.innovation: 强调轨迹级信息在关联中的利用。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje._arxiv_id: Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Object Tracking.

2503.18338|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视觉跟踪中单一大模型难以同时处理不同图像块间多样化关系建模的问题。②提出SPMTrack，基于为跟踪任务定制的混合专家（TMoE），结合多个专家能力灵活处理关系建模，并将关系建模从图像对扩展到时空上下文。③相比已有单流Transformer跟踪器，TMoE作为参数高效微调方法，显著减少可训练参数，同时保持预训练模型泛化能力。④实验表明，在最小参数增加下提升跟踪精度，并支持不同规模模型的高效训练。
2503.18338|v2.summary_en: ①This paper tackles the issue that a single Vision Transformer in one-stream trackers cannot effectively handle diverse relation modeling across image patches. ②It proposes SPMTrack with a tracking-specific mixture-of-experts (TMoE), enabling flexible relation modeling and extending to spatio-temporal context. ③Compared to existing trackers, TMoE serves as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method, drastically reducing trainable parameters while preserving pretrained generalization. ④Experiments show improved tracking accuracy with minimal parameter overhead and efficient training across scales.
2503.18338|v2.assessment: 方法创新性强，结合MoE与参数高效微调，对视觉跟踪领域有显著贡献，实验充分。
2503.18338|v2.contribution: 提出基于TMoE的SPMTrack，实现高效且准确的视觉跟踪。
2503.18338|v2.innovation: 将混合专家机制适配于跟踪任务，并用于参数高效微调。
2503.18338|v2.result: 在参数增加极小的情况下提升跟踪精度。

Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视觉跟踪中预训练模型缺乏任务特定时序信息的问题。②提出自回归序列预训练方法，可能通过预测未来帧或目标状态来增强跟踪器的时序建模能力。③相比传统静态预训练，该方法引入序列预测任务，提升对动态场景的适应性。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果无法评估，但该思路对视频跟踪有潜在价值。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the lack of task-specific temporal information in pretrained models for visual tracking. ②It proposes autoregressive sequential pretraining, likely predicting future frames or target states to enhance temporal modeling. ③Compared to static pretraining, it introduces sequence prediction tasks for better dynamic scene adaptation. ④Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract, but the idea holds potential for video tracking.
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.assessment: 摘要缺失，但自回归预训练方向新颖，可能对跟踪的时序理解有贡献。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.contribution: 提出自回归序列预训练方法用于视觉跟踪。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.innovation: 将自回归预测引入跟踪预训练阶段。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo._arxiv_id: Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining for Visual Tracking.

Exploring Historical Information for RGB.summary_cn: ①该论文针对RGBE（RGB+事件）视觉跟踪中历史信息利用不足的问题。②提出基于Mamba架构的方法，探索历史信息以增强跟踪鲁棒性。③相比传统Transformer，Mamba可能提供更高效的长序列建模能力。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果无法量化，但结合事件相机与Mamba是前沿方向。
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.summary_en: ①This paper addresses insufficient use of historical information in RGBE (RGB+event) visual tracking. ②It proposes a Mamba-based method to explore historical cues for robust tracking. ③Compared to Transformers, Mamba may offer efficient long-sequence modeling. ④Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract, but combining event cameras with Mamba is cutting-edge.
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.assessment: 摘要缺失，但RGBE跟踪与Mamba结合具有创新性，值得关注。
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.contribution: 提出基于Mamba的RGBE跟踪方法，利用历史信息。
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.innovation: 将Mamba架构应用于RGBE多模态跟踪。
Exploring Historical Information for RGB._arxiv_id: Exploring Historical Information for RGBE Visual Tracking with Mamba.

GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.summary_cn: ①该论文针对类别级服装姿态跟踪中的2D形变与3D重建集成问题。②提出GaPT-DAR方法，结合2D形变和3D重建进行姿态跟踪。③相比已有工作，可能更关注服装的柔性形变建模。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果无法评估，且该主题与自动驾驶感知相关性较低。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.summary_en: ①This paper addresses category-level garment pose tracking by integrating 2D deformation and 3D reconstruction. ②It proposes GaPT-DAR to combine these cues for pose tracking. ③Compared to existing methods, it may focus on flexible deformation modeling. ④Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract, and the topic has limited relevance to autonomous driving.
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.assessment: 主题偏向机器人操作，与自动驾驶感知关联度低，创新性一般。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.contribution: 提出集成2D形变与3D重建的服装姿态跟踪方法。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.innovation: 结合形变与重建处理柔性物体跟踪。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T._arxiv_id: GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose Tracking via Integrated 2D Deformation and 3D Reconstruction.

TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.summary_cn: ①该论文针对3D点云跟踪中类别特定模型泛化性差的问题。②提出TrackAny3D，通过迁移预训练3D模型实现类别统一的点云跟踪。③相比已有方法，该方法可能利用大规模预训练模型的知识，减少对类别特定数据的依赖。④摘要中未提供具体数据，但该思路对自动驾驶中的通用目标跟踪具有重要价值。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.summary_en: ①This paper addresses poor generalization of category-specific models in 3D point cloud tracking. ②It proposes TrackAny3D, transferring pretrained 3D models for category-unified tracking. ③Compared to existing methods, it leverages large-scale pretrained knowledge to reduce category-specific data dependence. ④Specific results are not provided in the abstract, but the approach is highly valuable for general object tracking in autonomous driving.
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.assessment: 方法具有高实用性和创新性，对自动驾驶多类别目标跟踪有直接推动作用。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.contribution: 提出TrackAny3D，实现类别统一的3D点云跟踪。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.innovation: 利用预训练3D模型迁移实现跨类别跟踪。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.result: 效果未量化，但概念验证了通用跟踪的可行性。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M._arxiv_id: TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D Models for Category-Unified 3D Point Cloud Tracking.

2412.02129|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对野外场景下通用3D单目标跟踪（SOT）缺乏大规模基准的问题。②提出了GSOT3D基准，包含620个序列、123K帧，覆盖54个目标类别，并提供点云、RGB图像和深度多模态数据，支持单模态和多模态3D跟踪任务。③相比现有基准，GSOT3D在类别覆盖、序列规模和模态多样性上显著扩展，且所有标注经过多轮人工精修。④评估了8种代表性点云跟踪模型，结果显示它们在GSOT3D上性能大幅下降，表明现有方法在通用性和鲁棒性上仍需改进。
2412.02129|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale benchmarks for generic 3D single object tracking in the wild. It introduces GSOT3D, a benchmark with 620 sequences, 123K frames, 54 categories, and multi-modal data including point cloud, RGB, and depth. Evaluation of eight existing trackers shows significant performance degradation, highlighting the need for more robust and generic methods.
2412.02129|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了通用3D单目标跟踪领域的空白，对推动鲁棒跟踪算法研究具有重要价值。
2412.02129|v2.contribution: 构建了最大规模的通用3D单目标跟踪基准GSOT3D，支持多模态和多任务评估。
2412.02129|v2.innovation: 首次提供覆盖54类、多模态的野外3D跟踪基准，并系统评估现有方法。
2412.02129|v2.result: 现有8种点云跟踪器在GSOT3D上性能大幅下降，揭示了通用3D跟踪的挑战。

2503.08145|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OV-MOT）中忽略轨迹信息的问题，导致遮挡和类别模糊时关联与分类不稳定。②提出了TRACT，一个利用轨迹信息增强关联和分类的开放词汇跟踪器，包含轨迹一致性强化（TCR）策略和即插即用的轨迹分类模块TraCLIP，后者集成轨迹特征聚合（TFA）和轨迹语义增强（TSE）。③相比现有依赖实例级检测和关联的方法，TRACT通过轨迹信息提升身份和类别一致性，增强对新颖类的适应性。④实验表明，TRACT在OV-MOT基准上显著提升了跟踪性能，尤其在遮挡和类别模糊场景下。
2503.08145|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of ignoring trajectory information in open-vocabulary multi-object tracking, which harms association and classification under occlusion and category ambiguity. It proposes TRACT, a tracker with a Trajectory Consistency Reinforcement strategy and a plug-and-play TraCLIP module that aggregates and enriches trajectory features. Experiments show improved tracking performance, especially in challenging scenarios.
2503.08145|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地利用轨迹信息解决开放词汇跟踪的关联和分类问题，具有较强实用价值。
2503.08145|v2.contribution: 提出轨迹感知的开放词汇跟踪框架TRACT，有效提升遮挡和类别模糊下的跟踪鲁棒性。
2503.08145|v2.innovation: 引入轨迹一致性强化和轨迹语义增强模块，充分利用轨迹信息。
2503.08145|v2.result: 在OV-MOT任务上取得显著性能提升，验证了轨迹信息的有效性。

Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.summary_cn: ①该论文针对指代多目标跟踪（Referring Multi-Object Tracking）中语言描述与视觉特征对齐不充分的问题。②提出了语言解耦与细粒度知识引导的方法，通过解耦语言特征并利用细粒度知识增强目标关联。③相比现有方法，该方法能更精确地利用语言信息指导跟踪过程，减少歧义。④实验在相关基准上验证了方法的有效性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient alignment between language descriptions and visual features in referring multi-object tracking. It proposes a language decoupling approach with fine-grained knowledge guidance to enhance object association. The method improves tracking accuracy by reducing ambiguity in language-guided scenarios.
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.assessment: 该研究为语言引导的跟踪任务提供了新思路，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.contribution: 提出语言解耦与细粒度知识引导的指代多目标跟踪方法。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.innovation: 通过语言特征解耦和知识引导提升跟踪关联精度。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.result: 在指代跟踪基准上取得改进，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn._arxiv_id: Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Knowledge Guidance for Referring Multi-Object Tracking.

VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.summary_cn: ①该论文针对开放词汇多目标跟踪中原始视频数据利用不足的问题。②提出了VOVTrack，探索从原始视频中挖掘潜力以提升开放词汇跟踪性能。③相比现有方法，VOVTrack可能通过自监督或视频级特征学习增强对未见类别的泛化能力。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但表明方法在相关任务上具有潜力。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of raw video data in open-vocabulary multi-object tracking. It proposes VOVTrack to explore the potential of raw videos for improving tracking performance. The method aims to enhance generalization to unseen categories, though specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.assessment: 该工作关注原始视频利用，对开放词汇跟踪的泛化性有潜在贡献，但细节不足。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.contribution: 提出VOVTrack，探索原始视频在开放词汇跟踪中的潜力。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.innovation: 利用原始视频信息增强开放词汇跟踪的适应性。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.result: 摘要未提供具体效果数据，需查阅全文。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in._arxiv_id: VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in Raw Videos for Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Tracking.

2508.21060|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对单目3D点跟踪在深度模糊和遮挡下的局限性，以及多相机方法需大量相机和逐序列优化的不足。②提出了首个数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪器，通过前馈模型直接预测3D对应关系，使用少量相机（如4个）实现鲁棒在线跟踪。③相比现有方法，该跟踪器融合多视角特征到统一点云，结合k近邻相关和Transformer更新，无需逐序列优化。④在5K合成序列上训练，在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上分别达到3.1cm和2.0cm的中位轨迹误差，并泛化到1-8视角和24-150帧视频。
2508.21060|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces the first data-driven multi-view 3D point tracker for arbitrary points in dynamic scenes, overcoming monocular depth ambiguity and occlusion. It uses a feed-forward model with k-nearest-neighbors correlation and transformer updates, requiring only a few cameras. The method achieves median trajectory errors of 3.1 cm and 2.0 cm on two real-world benchmarks, demonstrating strong generalization.
2508.21060|v2.assessment: 该工作开创性地解决多视角3D点跟踪，方法高效且泛化性强，对动态场景理解有重要价值。
2508.21060|v2.contribution: 提出首个前馈多视角3D点跟踪器，实现少量相机下的鲁棒在线跟踪。
2508.21060|v2.innovation: 融合多视角特征到点云并采用Transformer更新，无需逐序列优化。
2508.21060|v2.result: 在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上分别达到3.1cm和2.0cm的中位轨迹误差。

2507.05899|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多模态跟踪中传感器同步问题导致的时间不完整数据，现有跟踪器性能显著下降。②提出了一个灵活框架，通过异构专家混合（MoE）融合机制和视频级掩码策略，动态适应缺失模态。③相比刚性架构的现有方法，该框架能根据缺失率动态激活计算单元，并保持时间一致性和空间完整性。④实验表明，模型不仅适应不同缺失率，还能根据场景复杂度调整，显著提升鲁棒性。
2507.05899|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation in multimodal tracking under temporally incomplete data due to sensor synchronization issues. It proposes a flexible framework with a Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts fusion mechanism and video-level masking to dynamically handle missing modalities. The model adapts to varying missing rates and scene complexity, improving robustness.
2507.05899|v2.assessment: 该研究首次系统研究时间不完整多模态数据下的跟踪问题，提出的自适应框架具有较强实用性和创新性。
2507.05899|v2.contribution: 提出自适应多模态跟踪框架，有效处理时间不完整数据。
2507.05899|v2.innovation: 引入异构MoE融合和视频级掩码策略，实现动态适应。
2507.05899|v2.result: 模型在不同缺失率和场景复杂度下均保持鲁棒性能。

LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_cn: ①针对端到端多目标跟踪中关联模块设计不足、难以学习有效关联的问题。②提出LA-MOTR，引入可学习关联模块，通过可学习的关联查询和注意力机制增强帧间目标关联。③相比传统基于启发式匹配或简单注意力关联的方法，该方法将关联过程端到端可学习化，提升跟踪一致性。④在MOT17等基准上取得有竞争力的性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of learning effective associations in end-to-end multi-object tracking. It proposes LA-MOTR with a learnable association module using learnable queries and attention to enhance inter-frame matching.
